{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of 999999.99 (internal test orders)
internal_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(internal_orders)}")

# Check for commas in the revenue column
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Sample of entries with commas
comma_sample = df[has_commas]['revenue'].head().tolist()
print(f"Sample of revenue entries with commas: {comma_sample}")"}
